title: Taiwan's TCC plots European listing as green revenues overtake home market
content: Taiwan Cement Corporation (TCC) Group Holdings is evaluating a listing in Europe as it expands its low-carbon cement and green energy businesses across the region. TCC chairman Nelson An-ping Chang said the company is assessing the move but did not disclose a timetable or details.
